sets.title: India daily practice · English
sets.description: Short India-based scenarios for a clear, respectful next question.

items.prompt: A procurement lead in Pune says, “Our plant manager should be part of this decision.” What is the most useful next move?
options: Ask what the plant manager needs to evaluate.
Offer a discount for deciding without them.
Assume the decision will be delayed.
items.feedback: A stakeholder is useful context, not an obstacle. Ask what they need to evaluate before suggesting a next step.
items.hint: Follow the person’s stated decision process before proposing a solution.

items.prompt: A buyer in Mumbai says, “Please give us time to compare this with our current process.” What should you clarify first?
options: Which parts of the current process they want to compare.
Why they have not decided today.
Whether a bigger discount would end the comparison.
items.feedback: A comparison request does not explain the buyer’s criteria. Invite them to share what they want to compare.
items.hint: Ask about the decision criteria you do not yet know.

items.prompt: A team in Nagpur says, “Our budget review is next quarter.” What is established by that statement?
options: The timing of their budget review.
That they want a price cut.
That they will definitely buy next quarter.
items.feedback: The timing is clear; interest, budget and a future purchase are not established. Keep those questions open.
items.hint: Separate what was said from what you are tempted to predict.

sets.title: India daily practice · Hinglish
sets.description: Roz ke India-based scenarios, natural Hinglish mein, ek clear next question ke liye.

items.prompt: Pune ki team bolti hai, “Plant manager ko bhi is decision mein include karna hai.” Agla useful move kya hoga?
options: Poochho ki plant manager ko evaluate karne ke liye kya chahiye.
Unke bina decide karne ke liye discount offer karo.
Assume karo ki decision ab delay hi hoga.
items.feedback: Stakeholder ka hona normal decision process ka hissa ho sakta hai. Pehle samjho ki unhe kya evaluate karna hai.
items.hint: Jo decision process saamne wale ne bataya hai, usi ko explore karo.

items.prompt: Mumbai ka buyer bolta hai, “Humein current process ke saath compare karne ke liye thoda time chahiye.” Aap pehle kya clarify karoge?
options: Woh current process ke kaunse parts compare karna chahte hain.
Unhone aaj decide kyun nahi kiya.
Kya bada discount dekar comparison rok sakte hain.
items.feedback: Comparison ka matlab kya hai, yeh abhi clear nahi hai. Buyer ke criteria ko samajhne ke liye poochho.
items.hint: Jo criteria abhi pata nahi hai, uske baare mein open question poochho.

items.prompt: Nagpur ki team bolti hai, “Budget review next quarter hai.” Is statement se kya established hai?
options: Budget review ka timing.
Ki unhe price cut chahiye.
Ki woh next quarter pakka buy karenge.
items.feedback: Timing pata hai; interest, budget aur future purchase abhi prove nahi hue. Inhe assume mat karo.
items.hint: Jo bola gaya hai aur jo aap predict kar rahe ho, unko alag rakho.

sets.title: India daily practice · Marathi-English (Marlish)
sets.description: India-based daily scenarios in Marathi-English, with space to ask one clear next question.

items.prompt: Punechi team mhante, “Plant manager la pan ya decision madhye include karaycha aahe.” Pudhe konta step ghyal?
options: Plant manager la kay evaluate karaycha aahe te vichara.
Tyanchya shivay decision ghyayla discount offer kara.
Decision ata delay honarach asa assume kara.
items.feedback: Stakeholder la involve karne ha normal decision process asu shakto. Aadhee tyanna nemka kay evaluate karaycha aahe te samjun ghya.
items.hint: Samorcha vyaktine sangitlela decision process aadhi samjun ghya.

items.prompt: Mumbai madhla buyer mhanto, “Current process sobat compare karayla amhala thoda time pahije.” Tumhi aadhi kay clear karal?
options: Tyanna current process madhle konte parts compare karayche aahet te.
Tyanni aaj decision ka ghetla nahi.
Motha discount deun comparison thambel ka.
items.feedback: Comparison che criteria ajun clear nahi aahet. Buyer la nemka kay compare karaycha aahe te vichara.
items.hint: Ajun mahit naslelya criteria baddal ek open question vichara.

items.prompt: Nagpurchi team mhante, “Budget review next quarter aahe.” Ya statement madhun kay mahit padta?
options: Budget review cha timing.
Tyanna price cut pahije.
Te next quarter nakki buy kartil.
items.feedback: Timing samajla aahe; interest, budget ani future purchase ajun confirm nahi. Te assume karu naka.
items.hint: Je sangitle aahe te ani tumhi predict karta te vegle theva.
